title: Charity Basketball Tournament
summary: A fast-paced 3×3 streetball tournament every March — group stage, playoffs and prizes, with all proceeds going to charity.
description:
Every March our 3×3 streetball tournament fills Bilimkana Arena. Teams play through a group stage before the playoffs decide the winners.

Participation is paid, and all proceeds go to charity.
facts: Teams of up to five players
Prizes for the top three teams
impact: All proceeds from the tournament go to charity.
